author: CBR
description:
We dig into what comes next for Frank Castle in the MCU: how the hijacking of the Punisher skull could impact how he sees himself and his work. Then we pivot into the fun crossover talk, connecting The Bear cast to Marvel — including Ebon Moss-Bachrach as the Thing. 

Quick, nerdy, and straight to the point on why symbols and casting choices matter in Marvel’s street-level corner.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 16.
